---
title: "Teaching & service"
---

More than 25 years of teaching, from bachelor to doctoral level, in initial and work-study
programmes, for computer science and non-computer-science audiences.

## Doctoral courses (Dauphine–PSL doctoral school)

- **Evolutionary Machine Learning** (18 h): genetic programming for symbolic regression and interpretable classification,
  evolutionary clustering and community detection, scaling, evolutionary ensemble learning, feature selection and construction,
  hyperparameter optimization, neuroevolution.
- **Evolutionary Algorithms for Optimization and Machine Learning** (18 h, 2019).

## Current teaching (Université Paris Nanterre)

- **Machine learning** (M2 MIAGE, M2 D3S): regression, classification, clustering, ensemble learning, sampling, model selection.
- **Databases and NoSQL** (L2 to M1): relational model, advanced SQL, query optimization, MongoDB, Neo4j, Cassandra.
- **Python for data analysis** (M1–M2 economics): NumPy, Pandas, visualization.

Also: *Advanced Machine Learning II* (in English, ESILV, 2024–2025); *Advanced databases* (M2 IASD, Dauphine–PSL, 2023–2026).

## Responsibilities

- Co-director of the master's programme **IES–D3S** (Data Science for Social Sciences), Université Paris Nanterre (since 2022).
- Member of the computer science discipline committee (section 27), Université Paris Nanterre (since 2017).
- Vice-chair (2024) and member (2013, 2021) of recruitment committees.
- University coordinator of the *Digital Skills* course (over 2,000 students per semester, 2015–2020).
- Former head of the Applied Computer Science department, ESTI Tunis (2004–2008).

- **Reviewer for:** *Applied Intelligence* (Springer, 7 reviews since 2021), *SoftwareX* (Elsevier, 2026), *Expert Systems with Applications* (Elsevier, since 2020), *Journal of Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis* (Wiley, since 2024); formerly *Evolutionary Computation* (MIT Press) and *Quantitative Finance*. Verified reviews: [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4202-613X).

- **Scientific committee** of the research consortium **BleuAct** — *Le bleu en action : pour une production halio-alimentaire éco-innovante et durable* (CDR2024ES01, Tunisia), since 2025.
